preconditions.description: The length of good letters must be between 1 and 26.
The length of the pattern must be between 1 and 100,000.
The pattern must contain at most one '*' character.
The number of query strings must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(query) <= 10**5 for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query string must have a length between 1 and 100,000.
The total length of all query strings must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(match(pattern, query, good_letters) for query in queries) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if any query string matches the pattern, otherwise 'NO'.
